abilities.name: Curse of the Worgen (Trait)
abilities.description: Greymane can use certain Abilities to shapeshift between a Human and a Worgen. While Human, Greymane's Basic Attacks are ranged. While Worgen, Greymane gains 10 Armor, and his Basic Attacks become melee, but deal 40% more damage.; trait

fields.notes: Successfully mounting in the Worgen form shapeshifts Greymane back into Human, placing Darkflight on cooldown. Worgen bonus damage stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers affecting Greymane's Basic Attack damage. Does not stack with other positive Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

abilities.name: Gilnean Cocktail
abilities.description: Hurl a flask that deals 55 damage to the first enemy hit and explodes for 220 damage to enemies in a cone behind them. Worgen : Razor Swipe Swipe forward, damaging enemies hit.

fields.notes: 1) Splash radius grows from 1.5 to 6.0 over 0.3125 seconds in increments of 1.125. Enemies who are immune to skillshots can be hit by the splash, but not by the initial projectile, as long as they are not also immune to AoE.

abilities.name: Razor Swipe
abilities.description: Swipe in the targeted direction, dealing 126 damage to enemies hit. Human : Gilnean Cocktail Damage the first enemy hit and deal heavy damage behind them.

fields.notes: 1) After dashing, Greymane swipes a half circle shaped area in front of him. Greymane can move through units during Razor Swipe.

abilities.name: Inner Beast
abilities.description: Gain 50% Attack Speed for 3 seconds. Basic Attacks refresh this duration and reduce the cooldown of Inner Beast by 0.5 seconds.

fields.notes: Cooldown starts when the effect ends. Stacks additively with other effects that can affect Greymane's Attack Speed.

abilities.name: Darkflight
abilities.description: Shapeshift into a Worgen and leap at an enemy, dealing 88 damage. Worgen : Disengage Roll away and shapeshift into a Human.

abilities.name: Disengage
abilities.description: Roll away and shapeshift into a Human. Human : Darkflight Shapeshift into a Worgen and leap at an enemy.

abilities.name: Go for the Throat
abilities.description: Leap at an enemy Hero and shapeshift into a Worgen, slashing for 355 damage. If this kills them, the Ability can be used a second time within 10 seconds for free.; 80; 90; heroic

fields.type: Spell Damage / Movement: Launch, Status effect
fields.notes: 1) Greymane is Unstoppable during the leap until he reaches the target. Enemy Heroes low enough on Health to be killed by Go for the Throat are indicated to the player by a red skull above the unit when the Ability is not on cooldown. Go for the Throat places Disengage on cooldown if it was cast from Human form. The Ability is interrupted if the target moves 8.5 units past its range. Recast is granted if the target dies to anything within 0.1875s of being hit by this Ability.

abilities.name: Cursed Bullet
abilities.description: Greymane shapeshifts into a Human and fires a bullet that hits the first enemy Hero in its path, dealing 35% of their current Health in damage. Does not affect Vehicles.; 30; 50; heroic

fields.notes: Casting Cursed Bullet from either form does not affect the cooldown of Darkflight or Disengage.

talents.name: Wolfheart
talents.description: Increase the cooldown reduction from Basic Attacks during Inner Beast from 0.5 to 1.2 seconds, and Worgen Form's Armor bonus from 10 to 15.
_raw_fields: Increase the cooldown reduction from Basic Attacks during Inner Beast from 0.5 to 1.2 seconds, and Worgen Form's Armor bonus from 10 to 15.

talents.name: Perfect Aim
talents.description: Increases Gilnean Cocktail's range by 30% and refunds 45 Mana if it hits an enemy Hero.

fields.notes: Both initial projectile and splash count. Multiple hits do not grant more Mana.

_raw_fields: Increases Gilnean Cocktail's range by 30% and refunds 45 Mana if it hits an enemy Hero.

talents.name: Viciousness
talents.description: Increases Inner Beast's duration to 4 seconds, and causes Spell Damage to also refresh its duration.
_raw_fields: Increases Inner Beast's duration to 4 seconds, and causes Spell Damage to also refresh its duration.

talents.name: Thick Skin
talents.description: Using Darkflight grants 50 Physical Armor against the next 2 Hero Basic Attacks while in Worgen Form, reducing the damage taken by 50%.

fields.notes: Charges are lost immediately upon entering Human form. Does not stack with itself or other positive Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

_raw_fields: Using Darkflight grants 50 Physical Armor against the next 2 Hero Basic Attacks while in Worgen Form, reducing the damage taken by 50%.

talents.name: Eyes in the Dark
talents.description: Disengage grants Stealth for 3 seconds.

fields.notes: Greymane is unrevealable for the first 0.625 seconds of Stealth. Basic Attacking or using Abilities instantly removes Stealth.

talents.name: Insatiable
talents.description: Inner Beast causes Basic Attacks to restore 10 Mana, and reduce the cooldown of Healing Fountain by 0.5 seconds.
_raw_fields: Inner Beast causes Basic Attacks to restore 10 Mana, and reduce the cooldown of Healing Fountain by 0.5 seconds.

talents.name: Quicksilver Bullets
talents.description: Increases Human Basic Attack Range by 1.1.
_raw_fields: Increases Human Basic Attack Range by 1.1.

talents.name: Incendiary Elixir
talents.description: quest Reduce the cooldown of Gilnean Cocktail by 2 seconds. Every time Greymane hits an enemy Hero with the explosion damage from Gilnean Cocktail increase its explosion damage by 25, up to 375. After hitting 15 Heroes, the cooldown is reduced by an additional 3 seconds.

talents.name: Wizened Duelist
talents.description: questonly Every 6 Human Basic Attacks against Heroes increase Basic Attack damage by 1%, up to 30%. Worgen Basic Attacks grant credit for 3 Basic Attacks. Half of this bonus is lost upon death.

fields.notes: Upon death, incomplete stacks are nullified. The remaining damage bonus from completed stacks is truncated after halving. Stacks additively with itself and other offensive damage modifiers affecting Greymane's Basic Attack damage.

fields.notes: End area size is unaffected by the distance bonus.

talents.name: Eager Wolf

fields.notes: Stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers affecting Greymane's Basic Attack damage.

talents.description: Worgen Basic Attacks against Heroes deal bonus damage equal to 3% of the Hero's maximum Health.

talents.name: Unleashed
talents.description: Passive Go For The Throat's damage is increased by 25%. If Go For The Throat kills its target, reset the cooldowns of Greymane's Abilities.

fields.notes: Stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Go for the Throat 's damage. Reset is granted if the target dies to anything within 0.1875s of being hit by this Ability.
